newsitem.title: USA: Merck sees 1997 research spending up 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Merck sees 1997 research spending up 16 pct.

text.p: Pharmaceutical giant Merck and Co Inc said on Wednesday it expected to boost spending on research and development 16 percent to $1.7 billion in 1997 over 1996 levels.
The company spent about $1.5 billion on R&D in 1996, a spokesman said.
Earlier the company said it expected its fourth quarter earnings to be at the top of a $0.80 to $0.86 range of analysts' estimates and its 1997 earnings at the top of a $3.55 to $3.75 range.
